title: Explain why Capability::try_from("IMAP4rev2") is used instead of a named variant
description: In commands.rs, IMAP4rev2 is added to the capability list via Capability::try_from("IMAP4rev2") while all other capabilities (IDLE, NAMESPACE, ENABLE, etc.) use typed enum variants. There is no comment explaining that the imap-types crate does not expose a dedicated Imap4Rev2 variant, leaving contributors wondering whether this is a workaround or an oversight. A one-line comment at the call site would resolve this. Same pattern applies at both call sites in the capability list and in the test assertions.
